1	/**
    2	 * Mercury Bridge — Tool Adapter
    3	 * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    4	 * Exposes a canonical tool API to the ReAct loop while adapting to
    5	 * whatever method names the underlying ReadOnlyToolbox actually uses.
    6	 *
    7	 * Canonical tools exposed to Mercury via the ReAct loop:
    8	 *   grep       — literal string search across the repo (ground truth)
    9	 *   open_file  — read a specific line range from a non-ignored repo file
   10	 *   get_chunk  — retrieve a non-ignored indexed chunk by MongoDB _id
   11	 *   list_files — list non-ignored files in a directory
   12	 *   git_diff   — read current staged/worktree/last-commit diffs
   13	 *
   14	 * Why an adapter: keep Mercury's repo tools centralized so every evidence path
   15	 * shares the same repository boundary and skip policy.
   16	 *
   17	 * SAFETY: All paths are bounds-checked to the repo root. No writes.
   18	 * No arbitrary shell execution. The adapter is a strict subset of
   19	 * what ReadOnlyToolbox already considered safe.
   20	 */
